BEGIN; INSERT INTO sales.inventory(code) VALUES ('a'),('b'); REFRESH MATERIALIZED VIEW sales.inventory_totals; SELECT json_build_object('total',total)::text FROM sales.inventory_totals; ROLLBACK;
